scope: Fictional twins at public coordinates. No live MMSI. No nation teams. No fire.
win: Highest points at T+90. Tie-break: fewer misses, then first blood count.

cells.title: Circle over land
cells.prompt: Forty AIS tracks sit in a perfect 2 km circle over an inland airport. Speeds flip 0 kn and 100 kn. Class?
cells.teach: Many hulls, one inland point, cartoon speed = spoofed PNT on the plot.

cells.title: Lost lock
cells.prompt: Receivers drop fix. No shared fake airport. Class?
cells.teach: Jam = silence or random. Spoof = they agree on a wrong place.

cells.title: Radio vs plot
cells.prompt: Plot says off Romania. A VHF receiver at Kerch hears the same transmission. Class?
choices: Impossible RF path — the plot is the lie
cells.teach: AIS VHF is short-range. Geography of the receiver beats the pretty line.

cells.title: Two airports
cells.prompt: Same hour: ~50 tracks at Simferopol field and ~30 at Gelendzhik. What does the PAIR mean?
choices: One regional spoof event, two aim-points
cells.teach: Two land fields at once is theater-scale, not two bad boxes.

cells.title: Marina night
cells.prompt: Night FPV geotagged Dubai Marina, 250 ft, heliport-adjacent twin. Class?
choices: Unlawful UAS in a restricted urban / heliport buffer
cells.teach: The ring is the lesson. Not a US ticket on this map.

cells.title: DXB rings
cells.prompt: Track sits inside a published 5 km aerodrome buffer on a twin. Class?
cells.teach: Buffer geometry first. Height second.

cells.title: TPE cousin
cells.prompt: Same pattern over Songshan / TPE rings. Does Part 107 travel with you?
choices: No — local aerodrome law on the twin; Part 107 is a US drill
cells.teach: Cards drill topics. They are not a license in Taipei.

cells.title: 400 ft
cells.prompt: In the US Part 107 drill: max sUAS altitude without a structure exception?
cells.teach: 14 CFR 107.51. This card is a drill, not the certificate.

cells.title: Flat VLAN
cells.prompt: One OT VLAN holds L0 process, L1 PLC, L2 HMI, and a vendor laptop. Class?
cells.teach: Zones and conduits exist so that laptop is not in the process trust domain.

cells.title: No IDMZ
cells.prompt: Enterprise historian client talks straight to L2 HMI. Class?
cells.teach: L3.5 exists so enterprise does not sit on HMI.

cells.title: SL-T upside down
cells.prompt: SIS zone rated SL-1; enterprise BI rated SL-4. Class?
cells.teach: Safety kit does not get the weak target. Spreadsheets do not get SL-4 theater.

cells.title: 800-53 dump
cells.prompt: Team pasted an unmodified enterprise 800-53 High baseline onto an unpatchable L1 controller. Class?
choices: Wrong overlay — control cannot take the enterprise patch story
cells.teach: The overlay is the lesson. Compensating control ≠ open the PLC to the internet.

cells.title: Live MMSI
cells.prompt: You see a real MMSI on a public map during the Cup. What do you do?
cells.teach: Scope is the first skill.

cells.title: Fire key
cells.prompt: The HUD still says aim/fire. In this event that key means?
choices: Does not score. Classify or nothing
cells.teach: Observer, not belligerent.

cells.title: Card claim
cells.prompt: You sealed three cards. What did you earn?
cells.teach: Say it on the door. Cards are not certificates.

cells.title: Purple
cells.prompt: Purple on this range means?
choices: Detection quality at a coordinate — the call
cells.teach: Quality of the word. Not a write to the plant.

cells.title: Why London
cells.prompt: Why is London the flagship room?
choices: It is the only finished flyable city
cells.teach: Water decks teach classes. London is the place.

cells.title: Thames pin
cells.prompt: A dock twin on the Thames shows an open management plane. First class?
choices: Exposed ICS/OT management on a sandbox twin
cells.teach: Same OT class as Kharg. Different river.

cells.title: Mentor
cells.prompt: Beat 5 (coach) is real when?
choices: GET of this session works after refresh
cells.teach: Memory store is a mascot. A row that survives refresh is a coach.

cells.title: Hour end
cells.prompt: After 3–5 cards the Cup should?
cells.teach: Endgame for a trainer is the stop.
